title: Why You Hate Your Own Selfies
topic: You know your mirror-flipped face; the photo shows the unflipped one, and a close front camera also stretches your nose.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: Huge proven demand (24M). Gap is low; win on frame-0 split image.
